remarks: Welcome to this exceptional, generously sized home located in one of the area's most sought-after towns, known for its top-rated schools and vibrant community. Designed with space, comfort, and functionality in mind, this residence offers everything you need for elevated living. Step inside to discover expansive living areas perfect for both everyday life and entertaining. The home features a rare 4-car garage, ideal for car enthusiasts, extra storage, or even a workshop. Outdoors, enjoy a large private patio, perfect for relaxing or hosting gatherings, and unwind in your very own private sauna-a true luxury escape.
